description: Core generation, 20-band. Turn Praxis from a fixed 10-domain curriculum into a tool where a user defines ANY subject and AI generates a curriculum + scaffolds notebooks for it. This generalizes the existing curriculum.py (the hardcoded domain manifest) and scaffold_notebooks.py (which scaffolds blank rubric-shaped notebooks) into a subject-agnostic, AI-driven flow, and introduces the shared BYO-key LLM client the later bands reuse. Depends on the Tauri shell + preserved core from 10. Anti-fabrication: the generated curriculum + scaffolds must actually be produced and land on disk as valid rubric-shaped notebooks with 🔴 status — a story passes only when a newly defined subject really yields scaffolded notebooks and the gate is green.
warmup: ls notebooks/ | head; echo '--- an example scaffold ---'; find notebooks -name '*.ipynb' | head -1

userStories.title: BYO-key LLM client (agora optional)
acceptanceCriteria: A small LLM client (in the Python construction core, e.g. llm/ or praxis/llm.py) reads provider + API key from config/env for at least OpenAI, Anthropic, and a local/OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
When AGORA_BASE_URL is set, calls route through agora's provider-router instead; when unset, they go direct — documented in the README.
No API key is committed; keys come only from env/config. A unit test exercises the client against a mocked response for each routing mode.

userStories.title: User-defined subject → AI-generated curriculum
acceptanceCriteria: From the app, a user enters an arbitrary subject/goal (free text) and the AI generates a structured curriculum for it (modules → topics), each topic sized to work as one notebook, using the LLM client from US-1.
curriculum.py is generalized so the curriculum is data-driven per subject rather than the fixed 10 built-in domains (the built-ins remain as seed/example curricula).
The generated curriculum is persisted and shown in-app for review before scaffolding.
Gate green: pytest covers curriculum generation (with a mocked LLM) and passes.

userStories.title: Scaffold rubric-shaped notebooks for any generated curriculum
acceptanceCriteria: scaffold_notebooks.py is generalized to scaffold blank notebooks for ANY generated curriculum — each notebook carries the 8 rubric sections (docs/notebook-rubric.md) and reports 🔴 scaffold via nbstatus.py — not only the built-in manifest.
Defining a new subject end-to-end (subject → curriculum → scaffold) produces real .ipynb files on disk under a per-subject path, visible in the library from tasklist 10.
Re-scaffolding is idempotent: it never clobbers a notebook that already has content.
Gate green: pytest (including a test that scaffolds a generated subject) passes.
